$comment: §16 to §22. Start from least collection, because no construct exists to need more.

D0_FULL_RESPONSE.why: it would retain the publisher's content, which under GOV-1's condition moves the activity into SOURCE_COLLECTION and dissolves the track that justifies it

D1_HEADERS_AND_STATUS.why: all headers is too broad: Set-Cookie and the authenticate family carry user-specific and secret-like material, and retaining them by default would collect what nothing needs

D2_ALLOWLISTED_HEADERS_AND_STATUS.why: it is the least collection that still supports auditability, and an allowlist can be widened by a later run within a permitted set rather than having to be narrowed after the fact

D3_DERIVED_PREDICATE_ONLY.why: no predicate exists, so there is nothing to derive -- and storing only a derived boolean would destroy the auditability the accounting invariant is for

D4_TRANSIENT_RESPONSE_PERSIST_MINIMAL_AU.why: it is D2 without the allowlist's determinism; D2 is the same idea made checkable

body.$comment: §18 and §39. Two different questions, and confusing them is the trap.
body.why: a body-disabled apparatus still reads bytes off the socket, so a finite read cap is required whether or not anything is kept. Treating 'we do not store it' as 'we do not receive it' would leave the one bound that protects the operator machine unset.

headers.why_the_default_is_small: no construct exists, so nothing establishes which header a predicate will need. Choosing a wide default now would be choosing part of a construct.
headers.why_minimization_first: §22. A detector that misses one value has collected it. An allowlist that never contained it has not.

location_header.$comment: §20. Redirect provenance is needed and a Location can carry a token.
location_header.persisted_representation: scheme, host and path; query string dropped
location_header.how_that_is_avoided: the persisted record states that the query component was dropped, so a reader knows the representation is minimized rather than complete

the status line; the smallest thing that makes an observation an observation
